feeds.title: Planet Improv Blog
feeds.description: Planet Improv's entertainment and education services in the Charlotte area have kept children and adults laughing and learning for the past decade! We offer entertainment, hosting/MCing, classes, and corporate workshops for all ages, at any event. Our mission is to empower resilience through creativity.

feeds.title: Jimmy Carrane Blog
feeds.description: Jimmy Carrane Blog informs about performances and every detail which needs to be done in an Improv like listening to the audience, low-status improv characters for dummies, the need for improvisers to take an acting class, and many more!

feeds.title: The Blue Moment » Improvised Music
feeds.description: The posts from the Improvised Music section are on subjects like the last of AMM, music for absent dancers, in underground London, more music for the new society, and many more! The Blue Moment is a blog about music by Richard Willims.

feeds.title: Hoopla Blog
feeds.description: Hoopla's improv blog with a variety of helpful things for improvisers including exercises, improv tips, links to resources, and more. Hoopla is UK's 1st improv theatre, established over 12 years, as an improv comedy company based in London, UK. We aim to make improv fun and accessible for everyone from all backgrounds. We encourage and support a growing improv community with shows, courses, networking events, socials, and more.

feeds.title: Fernando's Improv Blog
feeds.description: Fernando's Improv believes that Improv life is my life. The blog provides articles on shows, theatre & spaces, teams, events, and more on topics like hosting the Latinx quiz show red door is the world's best improv team, and others!

feeds.title: Improv Everywhere
feeds.description: Improv Everywhere is a New York City-based comedy collective that stages unexpected performances in public places. We aim to surprise and delight random strangers through positive pranks. we have staged hundreds of projects involving tens of thousands of undercover performers. Highlights include making a time stop at Grand Central Terminal, giving Best Buy 100 extra employees, and letting random strangers conduct a world-class orchestra in the middle of Manhattan.

feeds.title: ImprovDr Blog
feeds.description: ImprovDr Blog is here for all your improvisational theatre and training needs! With over thirty years of professional experience as an improv deviser, director, performer, professor, and consultant, the improv doctor is ready to work for you. Whether you're interested in producing an existing improvisational work, commissioning or collaborating on a new custom-built show, or looking for training, coaching, or a one-of-a-kind corporate experience, you've come to the right place.

feeds.title: The Bridge Improv Theater Blog
feeds.description: Our new industrial-style space features a 50-seat adjustable comedy theater complete with a dynamic stage, wings, sound system, projector, and more! The theater aims to bring 'Clean and Clever Comedy' to Tempe, Arizona, and the valley beyond. The Bridge offers comedy classes ranging from improv to stand-up to sketch. In addition, the theater offers corporate shows and training.

feeds.title: Contact Improvisation Blog
feeds.description: Contact Improvisation Blog is about evangelizing, de-mystifying, supporting, and opining about the founder's favorite post-modern art sport. Many young dancers are hungry for more information about contact improvisation and this blog aims to answer all the unanswered queries.

feeds.title: The Maydays Blog
feeds.description: The Maydays Blog's Improv comedy company provides information on all the improv performances. We're The Maydays, an award-winning improvised comedy, and theatre company. As one of the UK's top schools for improv, we offer critically acclaimed live shows, workshops, corporate training, and more. We are working hard to try to provide the best quality online courses possible.

feeds.title: Improv Niagara Blog
feeds.description: Improv Niagara Blog is Niagara's home for Improv Comedy. We are an award-winning improv comedy theatre company based in the Niagara Region. We perform improv comedy shows and provide classes, workshops, and jams for all those interested in 'yes and' in this incredible region of the country.

feeds.title: Improv Wizards Blog
feeds.description: Improvisation is fun, creative, and essential for actors and anyone wanting to increase their moment-to-moment engagement in life. Join Improv Wizards and learn some improv! We started Improv Wizards to share with the world one of our greatest joys in life! Improvisation. Our way is to create lessons, video tips, blogs, and even fully improv courses so that you can learn improv skills from anywhere in the world.

feeds.title: Stephen Davidson Blog
feeds.description: Stephen Davidson is the Artistic Director of The Improvised Play, Improvable, QI: Queer Improv and more. I love to improvise with all kinds of different people and in all kinds of styles. I've made it my improv mission to keep my finger in as many improv pies as I can, and I love it! My blogs are all about viewpoints improv, community improv, performative wokeness, how to hold space, and many more!

feeds.title: Keyboard Improv Blog
feeds.description: Keyboard Improv is Ron's Blog on piano improv and the role of music in our lives. Hi! I'm Ron Drotos, and whether you're new to improv or are an experienced Jazz, Blues, or Rock pianist who wants to get up to the professional level, my step-by-step video lessons, sheet music, and personal guidance are a winning combination.

feeds.title: Katy Schutte Blog
feeds.description: Katy Schutte Blog is an improvisation blog by Katy Schutte; a London-based improviser. As an artist, I work with shared truth and autobiography to create theatre and improvised theatre with a sense of nostalgia that asks how perspective has changed us. My artwork retells my personal history, my passions, and my fears in a way that allows others to unlock theirs.

feeds.title: Santa Barbara Improv Blog
feeds.description: Santa Barbara Improv Blog is the dopest as they inform us on open improviews, different workshops, pandemics, sketch comedy shows, and more! Santa Barbara Improv is a comedy hub currently producing weekly short-form workshops, monthly shows, an ongoing series of long-form improv classes, and corporate improv training.

feeds.title: The Improfessor Blog
feeds.description: The Improfessor blog includes writings and publications about improvisational theatre by Theresa Robbins Dudeck, PhD. Dudeck is Keith Johnstone's literary executor and biographer and a theatre scholar-practitioner specializing in improvisation and applied improvisation, so her blog posts are often about how IMPRO, in practice and theory, can and does synergize with other disciplines and processes, within and beyond theatre, to promote new forms of intelligence and new ways of being in this world.

feeds.title: Courtyard Playhouse Improv Blog
feeds.description: Get top improve tips on what comes next, the hat game, speaking in one voice, three-word sentences, questions only, and more on the Courtyard Playhouse Improv Blog! We offer a program of improvisation, acting workshops, and performances for children and adults. We specialize in the delivery of corporate training and development and theatrical events.
